name: PdxSelect
description:
One control that is a select, a combobox or a multi-select, chosen by the searchable and multiple
props, fed by an array or a DataSource.

members.name: options
members.description: The selectable options.

members.name: source
members.description: DataSource instance — dedicated prop for data-driven select. Takes priority over options.

members.name: labelField
members.description: Object field used as the option label.

members.name: valueField
members.description: Object field used as the option value.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown while empty.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the control as invalid.

members.name: success
members.description: Applies the success state styling.

members.name: warning
members.description: Applies the warning state styling.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows a clear button to reset the value.

members.name: searchable
members.description: Adds a search box to filter options.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allow selecting more than one.

members.name: maxTagCount
name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a loading / busy state.

members.name: groupField
members.description: Object field used to group options.

members.name: label
members.description:
The combobox's accessible name, and its listbox's. Not needed inside a pdx-form-field with a
label, after a pdx-label, or with a <label for> the select's id: those name it.

members.name: searchPosition
members.description: Where to show search input: 'trigger' (default) or 'dropdown'

members.name: creatable
members.description: Allow creating new options when search has no match. Emits pdx-create.

members.name: createLabel
members.description:
Label template for the create option. Use {query} as placeholder. Empty: the select.create
component string, «Create "{query}"» in English.

members.name: remote
members.description: Enable debounced server-side filtering for remote DataSource.

members.name: debounce
members.description: Debounce delay in ms for remote search.

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value.

members.name: selectedItem
members.description: Read-only, via a ref: `el.selectedItem`.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to it.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

members.name: show
members.description: Open the popup.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the popup.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Open the popup when closed, close it when open.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popup opened (`true`) or closed (`false`): its open state, read-only, as an overlay's (#287).

events.name: pdx-clear
events.description: Fired when the clear button empties the selection, after its `value-change`.

events.name: pdx-search
events.description: Fired as the user types in the search input.

events.name: pdx-create
events.description: Fired when the user creates an option from the search text.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one option in the list: a snippet `item(option, index)`; `option.raw` is the original entry.
slots.signature: (option: { label: string; value: unknown; raw: T }, index: number)

slots.name: selected
slots.description: Renders the selected value in the trigger: a snippet `selected(option)`.
slots.signature: (option: { label: string; value: unknown; raw: T })

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The trigger: the frame, its border, background and the states' colours.

cssParts.name: search
cssParts.description: The search field, while `searchable`: in the trigger, or atop the list with `search-position="dropdown"`.

cssParts.name: tag
cssParts.description: A chosen option in the trigger, while `multiple`.

cssParts.name: clear
cssParts.description: The clear button, while `clearable`, something is chosen and neither `disabled` nor `readonly`.

cssParts.name: spinner
cssParts.description: The loading spinner, a `role="status"`, while loading.

cssParts.name: popup
cssParts.description: The floating panel that holds the list.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color
cssProperties.description: The trigger is the text input's frame, `.pdx-input-wrap`, and reads pdx-input's tokens (#761): its border at rest (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-focus
cssProperties.description: The frame's border while focused (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-invalid
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the invalid state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-success
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the success state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-warning
cssProperties.description: The frame's border in the warning state.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-width
cssProperties.description: The frame's bottom border, in the filled input style.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-focus-ring
cssProperties.description: The ring around the frame while focused.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-min-height
cssProperties.description: The frame's height, at the md size.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: `loading` is set, or the DataSource is loading.

cssStates.name: multiple
cssStates.description: `multiple` is set: the trigger holds tags.
